title: A cusp criterion for a local phase-space bottleneck in a minimal adiabatic Marcus Hamiltonian
summary: Marcus--Hush theory describes electron transfer through reorganization energies, driving forces, and electronic coupling, but it does not by itself determine when an adiabatic model possesses a local Hamiltonian bottleneck. We study a minimal asymmetric two-degree-of-freedom lower-sheet Hamiltonian with an exactly separable harmonic transverse mode. For this conservative model, we establish a necessary-and-sufficient root count for the stationary points and recover the known cusp boundary for disappearance of the lower-sheet double well.
